_meta.data: real parallel multilingual repo text (UN-6 + CoDa handout) + Latin colophon
_meta.what: a language is a composition (letter-frequency simplex); Hs reads its signature invariant to text amount above a sample floor

length_invariance_by_subsampling_same_te.reading: distance to the full signature shrinks as the sample grows (1.35 at 20%, 0.51 at 50%, 0 at full); at 5% it is unreliable -- the knowable-sample FLOOR, the same one the stress sheet found. Above the floor: the language is read, not the AMOUNT.

locked_discriminant_language_id.reading: classify a window to its language by its letter-composition; harder for the close Romance pair ES/FR on little data -- honest

latin_note: the Latin sample is short with structural zeros (k,w,y rare) -> distance UNRELIABLE (flagged); top letters reported; a full reading needs a real Latin corpus (the zero-handling limit, cf. E-21)
